answer: harbor verifies each operator and keeps every key on one identity count. ledge admits k active identities only while marble escrows 25 USDC times the square of k. The k-th identity therefore adds 25 USDC plus 50 USDC for each identity already present. At ten identities, 2,500 USDC stays locked and admission ten needs a 475-USDC top-up; a newcomer’s sole identity needs 25. Rotating wallets leaves the count unchanged, and concurrent applications cannot pledge the same capital twice.
